scripts.build:web:prod: EXPO_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/tlac-tailgate-like-a-champion-today EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE=remote EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://ministries-generic-inputs-spotlight.trycloudflare.com/api/v1 npx expo export --platform web --clear --output-dir dist
scripts.build:web:demo: EXPO_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/tlac-tailgate-like-a-champion-today/demo EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE=mock npx expo export --platform web --clear --output-dir dist-demo
scripts.build:web:all: rm -rf dist dist-demo && npm run build:web:prod && npm run build:web:demo && mkdir -p dist/demo && cp -R dist-demo/. dist/demo && rm -rf dist-demo && npm run copy:landing && touch dist/.nojekyll
scripts.preview:web: rm -rf .web-preview && mkdir -p .web-preview/tlac-tailgate-like-a-champion-today && cp -R dist/. .web-preview/tlac-tailgate-like-a-champion-today && npx serve .web-preview
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web:all && npx gh-pages -d dist -t
